scope.note: SWS-CORRECTIVE-01 R1. This file configures the legacy synth_king / live_orchestrator pipeline, which the shipped product does not launch: shell/modules/sovereign.json starts sovereign_product.server, whose QUICK and DEEP executors both resolve every model role from SYSTEM_MANIFEST.json MODELS. The rosters below therefore differ from the product's on purpose and are NOT the answer to 'what model is configured?'. sovereign_product opens this file only as an evidence document, so the declaration is stated here rather than only in a comment elsewhere: a reader handed this text as evidence must be able to see what it does and does not govern.

reconciliation_note: B2-6 (M-5/M-6, SWS-REM-DIR-20260828 R2): king_synthesizer.model reconciled to SYSTEM_MANIFEST.json MODELS.SYNTHESIZER. synth_king.py uses the hierarchy value first (king_cfg.get('model', args.model_synth)) with the manifest SYNTHESIZER only as fallback, so the previous value silently overrode the package-level synthesis assignment. All other hierarchy roles have no SYSTEM_MANIFEST counterpart and are unchanged.
